title: Rubio Gets a Medal. Russia Gets Military Drills. Karakalpakstan Gets Silence.
author: Gulya Nur
text:
Credit: Uzbekistan Presidency
On October 19, Uzbekistan’s President Shavkat Mirziyoyev awarded U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio the Order of Outstanding Merit. On October 20, UzDaily reported the arrival of Russian troops for joint military exercises in Uzbekistan. For Karakalpak families awaiting the release of political prisoners, neither announcement offered relief. Uzbekistan celebrated American investment and welcomed Russian soldiers while making no publicly announced commitment to people imprisoned for exercising and defending their rights.Mirziyoyev’s office announced $12 billion in agreements, while Rubio participated in the C5+1 ministerial meeting and witnessed Uzbekistan’s signing of the Artemis Accords on peaceful space exploration. Sustained American engagement with Central Asia serves legitimate interests, and investment can create opportunities across the region. But announced agreements must still become functioning projects. [...]
